Name: Dyeable Wedding Dress for farmer
Author: Asterisk555
Description:
Update: [Fashion Sense version can be found here](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12492)

_Short description_

*   Dyeable Wedding Dress for the farmer. The top replaces the 80's shirt and the skirt replaces the Baggy pants from the vanilla base game. You can dye these items with a sewing machine the same way you dye any other item of clothing. Recycle your wedding dress at every occasion! The way your great great grandma used to.

_Longer description_
There are also sleeves based on the ones in [whimsical girl](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8198) and I highly reccomend getting that mod because it has a much wider range of sleeves that change with the color of your shirt. Unfortunately because these sleeves are transparent there's only a red, and white option. I'm also only publishing the sleeves in one skin tone (for now) while the whimsical girl sleeves work for all skin tones. You can use [GMCM](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098)  so you can change when the dress replaces vanilla clothing while in game. The top and skirt will work for male and female avatars, but the sleeves are only for females.

_Compatibility_
This mod uses CP instead of JA so you can add it to a game mid-save without worrying about compatibility issues. Including those brought about by ye olde Json shuffle. Which is super great for those "oh, I'm getting married. Wait what am I even going to __wear"__ moments. It might be compatible for mobile but I don't have the mobile app and can't test it, if you do use android and find it works please let me know!

The spotty top and dress are inspired by the dress Maru wears in diverse stardew valley as designed by DesertDove. I have permissions! :D If I have time I might do the other dresses she designed as things the farmer can wear.

_Config options
_The config file will be generated the first time you launch the game with the mod in your mods folder. If using GMCM you can change the options in-game either from the home screen or in setting while you're in your save. If you're changing the options manually you will need to exit the game, type in the options you want in the config.json and re-launch the game.

Weddingtop: stoop, false
Weddingskirt: spots, plain, false
Weddingsleeves: red, white, false

_Fun things
_I have a [discord server](https://discord.gg/YPEN5fg7qG) now! Where I'll post wip art and you can make suggestions for new mods, ask for help, or just chat and show off your farm.  I also do [art and other comissions](https://ko-fi.com/asteriskart/gallery).
